2.3.23 Report.InteractiveWidth
Applies to RDL 2005/01
The Report.InteractiveWidth element specifies the default width for rendering a Report by an
interactive renderer. The Report.InteractiveWidth element is optional. If this element is present,
its value MUST be an RdlSize. If this element is not present, its value is interpreted as the value of
Report.PageWidth.
Following is the parent element of the Report.InteractiveWidth element.
Parent elements
Report
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Report.InteractiveWidth element.
 <xsd:element name="InteractiveWidth" type="SizeType" minOccurs="0" />
